subtitle: A semantic model, then a metric on top of it

code:
semantic_models:
  - name: orders
    model: ref('fct_orders')
    entities:
      - name: order_id
        type: primary
    dimensions:
      - name: order_date
        type: time
    measures:
      - name: order_total
        agg: sum
caption: Naming the roles fct_orders' columns already play — nothing new.

code:
metrics:
  - name: revenue
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: order_total
    filter: |
      {{ Dimension('order_status') }}
        != 'cancelled'
caption: The cancelled-orders filter lives in the metric, not in three separate tools.
Select Metrics: revenue. No SQL, no re-derived filter.
